business_scope.primary_industry_name: Design and Commissioning of Reverse Osmosis Water Treatment Works

meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: Germany (Federal Republic of Germany / Bundesrepublik Deutschland)
meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Germany (federal-level statutory unitary corporate and commercial law; GmbH registration is effected at the local Amtsgericht of the registered office district)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, Arts. 49 and 54 (freedom of establishment)
Germany–People's Republic of China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 1 Dec 2003; in force 11 Nov 2005)
Germany–United States Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (signed 29 Aug 1989; in force 21 Aug 1991; amended by 2006 Protocol)
Germany–United Kingdom Double Taxation Agreement (signed 30 Mar 2010; in force 30 Dec 2011)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Geldwäschegesetz (GwG) of 23 June 2017 (BGBl. I p. 1822), as most recently amended: Sections 2–17 (obligations of obliged entities), Section 3 (beneficial owner definition), Sections 18–28 (Transparency Register); Transparenzregister- und Finanzmarktinformationsgesetz (TraFinG) of 12 Aug 2021 (in force 1 Aug 2021; full-register regime); Gesetz betreffend die Gesellschaften mit beschränkter Haftung (GmbHG); Handelsgesetzbuch (HGB) Sections 17–37 (commercial firm); EU Directive (EU) 2015/849 (AMLD4), as amended by (EU) 2018/843 (AMLD5); Regulation (EU) 2015/847 (information accompanying transfers); Council Regulations (EU) No 269/2014 and No 833/2014 (restrictive measures); Federal Foreign Office legalization rules under German consular law.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national identity card of each ultimate beneficial owner and each managing director (identification under GwG Section 11(4))
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent civil registry, passport authority or consular post of the UBO's/director's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for Hague Convention member states; Consular Legalization by the German Embassy/Consulate for non-member states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or recent official extract from the home-country commercial register of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country company registry (e.g., Companies House, Trade Register, Registry Agency)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney executed by each foreign shareholder in favor of the German incorporation representative (required for notarial signature under GmbHG Section 2)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public notary in the shareholder's jurisdiction, with notarial certification and legalization
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization by German mission for non-member states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or audited source-of-funds document evidencing lawful availability of the EUR 25,000 stated capital (Stammkapital) for deposit into the notarial escrow account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Correspondent bank or statutory auditor of the founding shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or Consular Legalization of signatures where required by the notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: English/German executive translation of technical and financial documentation for the preliminary water-law assessment (Vorprüfung) under Water Resources Act Section 9 and the municipal drainage statutes
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Sworn translator (beeidigter Übersetzer) accredited by the competent German judicial authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic certification by the sworn translator; notarial signature confirmation where requested by the authority

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory multi-jurisdictional screening of all UBOs, managing directors, and project key personnel against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN/SSI list, and the German Federal Office for Economic Affairs and Export Control (BAFA) embargo database; politically exposed person (PEP) identification and monitoring in accordance with GwG Section 1 and BaFin implementing guidance, including the statutory five-year cooling-off period after cessation of public office; transactions involving high-risk third countries trigger enhanced due diligence and senior-management approval; given the World Bank escrow payment rail, the World Bank Group sanctions/debarment integrity database must be checked; all screening results must be documented in the AML documentation file under GwG Section 8 (record-keeping).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Handelsregister- und Unternehmensregisterportal (www.handelsregister.de; public retrieval at www.unternehmensregister.de); name availability check and reservation are submitted electronically by the notary to the competent Amtsgericht (Registergericht) of the district where the registered office (Sitz) is located
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal-form suffix 'Gesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung' or the commonly understood abbreviation 'GmbH' must be contained in the firm name (GmbHG Section 4); the distinct part of the name must be plainly legible in Latin script, and any non-Latin script element must be presented in a mandatory Latin transliteration; the name must not be misleading, must comply with the principle of firm-name truth (Grundsatz der Firmenwahrheit, HGB Section 18(1)), and must be distinguishably different from all existing registered names (Unterscheidbarkeit, HGB Section 30).
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank / Sparkasse / Kreditinstitut — requires prior BaFin ministerial license
Versicherung / Lebensversicherung — requires prior BaFin approval
Stadt / Städtisch / Kommune — public-law authority designation; generally prohibited or requires municipal consent
Bundes- / Staats- / Reichs- — implies public federal authority; prohibited for private commercial firms
Architekt / Ingenieur-Dienstleister — title-bearing tokens require chamber membership and license evidence
Apotheke / Krankenhaus / Klinik — sector-licensed tokens requiring the competent health authority's clearance
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Rejection is issued by the Registergericht as an interim order (Zwischenverfügung) or final refusal; the applicant may appeal within one month by filing a Beschwerde to the Landgericht (regional court) pursuant to FamFG Sections 58 and 63, with the possibility of a further Rechtsbeschwerde to the Oberlandesgericht where leave is granted; in parallel, a curative filing may be made via the notary using a modified distinctive name; the notary may also apply for a new Vorbescheid (advance name clearance certificate) for an additional fee to re-open or extend the reservation window where the court refuses an extension.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally acceptable. A serviced or virtual office address can satisfy the in-country business address (Geschäftsanschrift) filing requirement under GmbHG Section 10(1) and HGB Section 12, provided the provider offers lawful access, mail-forwarding, and no mailbox-only shell arrangement; for a municipal sewage-treatment EPC contractor operating under World Bank escrow payment rails and municipal concession review, a pure mailbox address is unsuitable and may undermine commercial substance; a serviced-office address with an actual project engineering premise in Germany is strongly recommended.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate; approximately 5–8% annualized probability of an unannounced Gewerbeamt physical inspection during the first 24 months, increasing to approximately 15% if the company is registered at a high-density virtual-office address with no local employees, no local lease, and no demonstrable operational equipment.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of Articles of Association (Gesellschaftsvertrag) and incorporation consultation, including UBO verification and statutory declaration annexes
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee scale under the Notarkostenordnung (GNotKG), Sections 97–99, on the EUR 25,000 reference Stammkapital; market benchmark approximately EUR 1,650–1,900

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability check and advance name clearance certificate (Vorbescheid) handled via notarial electronic filing with the Registergericht
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Court fee tariff and notary disbursement benchmark; approximately EUR 120–180

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial Register (Handelsregister) registration fee for GmbH entry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory court fee schedule (Gebührenverzeichnis GNotKG); approximately EUR 290–380 for a GmbH with EUR 25,000 capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Trade office registration (Gewerbeanmeldung) with municipal administrative processing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Municipal fee schedule (Verwaltungsgebührensatzung); EUR 20–110 depending on city

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preliminary water-law assessment (Vorprüfung) and application preparation under Water Resources Act (WHG) Section 9 and applicable Land water acts / municipal drainage statutes
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: State water authority (Wasserbehörde / Landesamt für Umwelt) and local drainage board
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Land regulatory fee ordinance (Landesgebührenordnung); prevailing market benchmark EUR 700–1,100

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified German translations of foreign corporate documents, apostilled documents and technical profiles
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator (beeidigter Übersetzer) or accredited translation agency
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; EUR 45–85 per standard page

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostilles and consular legalization for foreign notarial documents and corporate extracts
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Federal Foreign Office (Auswärtiges Amt), Federal Office of Administration (BVA), or German diplomatic mission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular fee regulation (Konsulargesetz-Gebührenverordnung); approximately EUR 35 per document plus courier

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered serviced office address in Germany, first 12 months, including mail management and premises compliance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent / serviced office provider (Frankfurt, Dusseldorf or comparable city)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; EUR 1,600–2,500 per annum depending on location and physical meeting-room rights

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Transparency Register (Transparenzregister) initial beneficial-owner filing and annual confirmation handling
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent / legal advisor (public filing fee for initial UBO data: EUR 0)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing fee-free; advisor administrative handling fee approximately EUR 200–250

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company seal (Firmenstempel), notarial dossier, expedited courier and disbursements
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary's office disbursements and external suppliers

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Gesetz betreffend die Gesellschaften mit beschränkter Haftung (GmbHG), §§1, 5, 8, 10, 35, 39 and 40; supplementary registration procedure under the Handelsgesetzbuch (HGB) and the FamFG requirements for commercial register filings; notarial execution in accordance with Beurkundungsgesetz.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Handelsregister (Commercial Register) maintained by the Registergericht department of the competent Amtsgericht; filings are transmitted electronically through the xJustiz portal / handelsregister.de.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Anmeldung zur Eintragung im Handelsregister (application for registration in the Commercial Register) together with the notarized limited-liability company agreement (Gesellschaftsvertrag), list of managing directors, list of shareholders, and bank capital-confirmation certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The statutory minimum nominal capital (Stammkapital) for a GmbH is EUR 25,000. Before registration, at least EUR 12,500 of cash contributions must be paid in and be freely at the disposal of the managing director, evidenced by a bank confirmation. If no free corporate bank account exists, capital may be escrowed with the notary on a GmbH-money account and released only upon registration; contributions in kind must be fully supplied and an asset valuation report submitted.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Gesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung adopts the Articles of Association presented to this notarial meeting, and that the share subscription list reflecting the subscribed initial capital as distributed among the founding shareholders is approved. RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company be established at [Registered Office Address, Germany], and that the Managing Directors are authorised to file the registration application with the Commercial Register. RESOLVED that the appointed Managing Directors accept office with sole representation authority, subject to any restrictions recorded in the Articles of Association, and are authorised to open bank accounts, sign all formation ancillaries, appoint the first tax adviser, and take every action necessary to complete company formation and lawful commencement of business operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and notarizing Articles of Association and share subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary office (Notar) in Germany authorized to perform incorporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Provide founders' passport data, proposed GmbH name, registered office, and business object covering municipal sewage treatment and reverse-osmosis water treatment works. The notary drafts or certifies the Articles of Association and share subscription declaration, reads the deed aloud, notarizes signatures, and prepares the registration application for later submission to the Handelsregister.
required_dossiers: Notarial deed of incorporation and Articles of Association (Gesellschaftsvertrag)
List of founding shareholders and subscribed shares
Identification documents of all founders and managing directors
Business-object statement matching ISIC 4220 / water-treatment and sewage-infrastructure activities
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies inconsistencies in the corporate name, registered office, or business object, correct and amend the draft and re-notarize without any additional statutory waiting period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of minimum paid-up capital on the GmbH bank escrow or contribution account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: German credit institution or notarial escrow agent under notary instructions
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a separate GmbH money account in the company's name and deposit at least EUR 12,500 for a cash-contribution GmbH, or place the contribution in notarial escrow. Obtain a bank confirmation (Bankbestätigung) stating that the capital is at the free disposal of the managing director. Non-cash contributions, if any, must be fully transferred and documented by a valuation report.
required_dossiers: Payment receipts or escrow release instructions
Valuation report for contributions in kind, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or escrow agent queries beneficial ownership or source of funds, supplement identification documents and confirm the account name; if the deposited capital is below the statutory minimum, make an additional transfer before submitting the registration application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the Commercial Register registration application through the notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Handelsregister (Registergericht) at the competent Amtsgericht; transmitted electronically via xJustiz portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary submits the signed application for registration together with the notarial incorporation deed, Articles of Association, list of managing directors, certified specimen signatures, shareholder list, bank capital confirmation, and, if relevant, preliminary permits or necessary consents. The Registergericht examines legal compliance, capital guarantee, and directors' eligibility.
required_dossiers: Full text of Articles of Association and incorporation deed
List of managing directors with certified specimen signatures
Consent or qualification documents of the founders or supervisory bodies, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the register court issues an objection (Zwischenverfügung), the notary files an auxiliary statement within the fixed period. If registration is refused, the company may file a complaint (Beschwerde) under the FamFG, followed by an appeal to the Higher Regional Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of registration certificate and Commercial Register extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After positive examination, the court registers the GmbH, assigns the commercial register number, and issues an electronic extract (Handelsregisterauszug) and notice of registration. Legal existence of the GmbH commences with the registration entry; thereafter, file any required Transparenzregister (beneficial ownership) declaration and maintain statutory register documents.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of the managing directors
Power of attorney if retrieval is made by a third-party service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the register extract is incomplete or contains erroneous entries, request formal rectification by the court under the register regulation, or lodge a supplementary filing with the Registergericht.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, trade, and occupational registrations after incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Finanzamt (local Tax Office), Gewerbeamt (Trade Office) if applicable, and Berufsgenossenschaft der Bauwirtschaft (BG BAU)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the tax registration questionnaire (Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung) with the local Finanzamt to obtain the income-tax number and, if required, VAT identification number. If the company will carry on a trade, file the Gewerbeanmeldung; register the operating site with the competent employers' liability insurance association and report beneficial-owners data to the Transparenzregister.
required_dossiers: Tax registration questionnaire for corporate tax, trade tax, and VAT purposes
Managing directors' identification and register of beneficial owners (Transparenzregister entry)
Gewerbeanmeldung form if the activity constitutes a trade not already covered by statutory merchant status
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Finanzamt delays issuing tax numbers, send a reminder and, if necessary, file an administrative inaction appeal. For trade-office queries, amend the Gewerbeanmeldung and provide supplementary information; any administrative enforcement follows after the permit certificate is posted.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Landesumweltamt (State Environment Agency) or Gewerbeaufsichtsamt (Industrial Supervisory Authority), depending on the Bundesland and installation class under the 4. BImSchV; for sewage treatment plants, also the competent water authority under the Wasserhaushaltsgesetz (WHG).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Immissionsschutzrechtliche Genehmigung nach §4 Bundes-Immissionsschutzgesetz (BImSchG) and Plangenehmigung oder Wasserrechtsbescheid under the Wasserhaushaltsgesetz (WHG) for the construction, commissioning, and operation of the municipal sewage treatment and reverse-osmosis water treatment plant.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Umweltbundesamt (Federal Environment Agency) as the technical standards-setting authority; operative EIA approval is issued by the competent Landesumweltamt or the state planning authority under UVPG.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full EIA Report (UVP-Pflicht) is generally compulsory for municipal wastewater treatment installations above the capacity thresholds set out in UVPG Annex 1; smaller installations are subject to a general or site-related preliminary assessment (Vorprüfung) with public participation and environmental-screening documentation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Abwasserverordnung (AbwV), Annexe relevant to municipal wastewater, including concentration thresholds for COD, BOD5, NH4-N, total nitrogen, and total phosphorus; sludge treatment and incineration must meet 17. BImSchV and sewage-sludge ordinance requirements; VOC emissions from process equipment must comply with TA Luft; residual ozone and chemical-dosing hazards must be controlled under occupational and water-protection rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification (Brandschutznachweis) under the Landesbauordnung; structural-load and static verification by a licensed structural engineer; civil-defense and extraordinary-hazard review under Störfall-Verordnung if chlorine, ammonia, or other hazardous process chemicals are stored; occupational health clearance by the Gewerbeaufsichtsamt and BG BAU in accordance with Arbeitsstättenverordnung and Betriebssicherheitsverordnung, including regular inspection of technical equipment, electrical installations, and confined-space entry procedures.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Federal Central Tax Office (Bundeszentralamt für Steuern – BZSt) for VAT identification number (USt-IdNr.) issuance, withholding tax clearance, and cross-border refunds; local Tax Office (Finanzamt) for corporate income tax (Körperschaftsteuer), trade tax (Gewerbesteuer), and VAT assessment and collection; all filings are made through the ELSTER electronic portal (www.elster.de); primary federal portal: www.bzst.de.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-owned German GmbH: (1) notarize the articles of association and apply for entry in the Commercial Register (Registereintragung) at the local Amtsgericht; (2) within four weeks of commencing business, file the 'Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung' (tax registration questionnaire) electronically via ELSTER, declaring shareholders, managing directors, planned activities, and estimated turnover; (3) the local Finanzamt assigns the 11-digit Steuernummer (tax number) used for corporate income tax, trade tax, payroll tax, and VAT returns; (4) separately apply to the BZSt for the USt-IdNr. (VAT identification number, format DE + 9 digits) via the BZSt/ELSTER electronic application; (5) non-resident shareholders do not require a German physical presence, but must produce certified constitutional documents and, where dividend distributions are planned, may claim treaty relief through the BZSt FVI withholding tax clearance procedure.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: German law contains no US-style check-the-box election; a domestic GmbH is mandatorily classified as a corporation (Kapitalgesellschaft) subject to corporate income tax and trade tax at entity level. Available statutory mechanisms and elections: (i) Organschaft (fiscal unity) under §§ 14–19 KStG, § 2 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 GewStG, and § 2 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 UStG – the GmbH may be consolidated for corporate income tax, trade tax, and VAT with a qualifying parent through a profit-and-loss pooling agreement (Gewinnabführungsvertrag) and financial integration; (ii) § 1a KStG transparency option – an EU/EEA-incorporated company comparable to a German partnership may elect transparent partnership taxation for German purposes, but this is not available to a domestically incorporated GmbH; (iii) hybrid mismatch rules under § 4k EStG (ATAD 2) operate as mandatory correction rules without elective carve-outs; (iv) trade tax apportionment elections apply to multi-establishment structures; no election exists to re-characterize the GmbH itself.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Umsatzsteuer) – German value added tax harmonized with Council Directive 2006/112/EC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Germany imposes no genuine VAT registration threshold: every entrepreneur (Unternehmer) engaged in business activity is mandatorily a VAT taxpayer from the first transaction. The only monetary relief is the small-business exemption (Kleinunternehmerregelung, § 19 UStG), which relieves output VAT only where prior-year taxable turnover did not exceed EUR 22,000 and current-year turnover is not expected to exceed EUR 50,000 (from 1 January 2025: EUR 25,000 prior-year and EUR 100,000 current-year under EU Directive 2020/285). An EPC contractor GmbH supplying design and commissioning services for municipal sewage and reverse osmosis water treatment works will exceed these thresholds and must register, file, and account for German VAT from the first transaction.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Phased B2B e-invoicing mandate under the Growth Opportunities Act (Wachstumschancengesetz): from 1 January 2025 every German- based entrepreneur must be able to receive structured electronic invoices (CEN EN 16931 formats: XRechnung or ZUGFeRD/Factur-X 2.x); from 1 January 2027 e-invoice issuance becomes mandatory for businesses with prior-year turnover above EUR 800,000; from 1 January 2028 e-invoice issuance is mandatory for all businesses. Germany does NOT operate a real-time fiscal clearance or API digital-stamping system: the BZSt and Finanzämter perform no pre-issuance authorization or stamping of invoices. VAT compliance remains periodic and electronic: monthly or quarterly advance VAT returns (Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen) and the annual VAT return must be filed via ELSTER; intra-Community sales are reported via the Zusammenfassende Meldung. An EU ViDA-style real-time digital e-reporting framework is expected but is not yet in force.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: German law achieves the 0% effective export rate through statutory VAT exemption with full input VAT deduction (steuerfrei mit Vorsteuerabzug), not through a separate zero-rate. Eligibility: (i) export supplies of goods leaving the EU customs territory (Ausfuhrlieferung, § 4 Nr. 1 lit. a, § 6 UStG) where the seller or the foreign buyer transports the goods to a third-country destination and the seller holds the customs export confirmation (Ausfuhrnachweis issued via the ATLAS system); (ii) intra-Community supplies (§ 4 Nr. 1 lit. b, § 6a UStG) where the buyer is VAT-registered in another EU member state, the buyer's valid USt-IdNr. is stated on the invoice, and the goods are transported to that other member state, supported by cumulative commercial and transport evidence; (iii) services supplied B2B to entrepreneurs established abroad whose place of supply is outside Germany under § 3a UStG (reverse charge at the recipient's seat) – including engineering design, consultancy, and EPC-related offshore services, so no German VAT is charged; (iv) ancillary installation or commissioning services physically associated with exported goods under § 6 Abs. 6 UStG. The exemption requires compulsory documentary and accounting evidence (Buch- und Belegnachweis) maintained at the time of the tax audit.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Ausfuhranmeldung) processed via the ATLAS system and confirmed by customs as 'Exportgefolgt' – the Ausfuhrnachweis is the primary evidence of physical EU exit
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or CMR road consignment note evidencing transport of the goods to the third-country destination
Inward Remittance Certificate: bank SWIFT MT103 or payment-ledger entries evidencing receipt of the foreign buyer's payment and FX repatriation within the 180-day benchmark
Commercial invoice and packing list stating Incoterms allocation and third-country destination
Intra-Community Sales List (Zusammenfassende Meldung – ZM) and the buyer's valid VAT identification number for EU-desk (intra-Community) supplies
Contracts, delivery notes, order-correspondence, and warehouse/transport records substantiating direct shipment and uninterrupted transport chain
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Finanzamt external audits (Außenprüfung) apply the cumulative-evidence standard (Gesamtwürdigung) under §§ 6 UStG and 13 UStDV. Where export documentation, transport-chain proof, or the 180-day payment/repatriation evidence is missing, incomplete, contradictory, or false, the exemption is retroactively denied: output VAT becomes due on the full invoice value, input VAT is clawed back, interest on additional tax accrues under § 233a AO at 0.15% per month (1.8% per annum for periods from 1 January 2019), and late-payment surcharges (Säumniszuschläge) of 1% per commenced month may apply. Intentional or reckless false export substantiation constitutes tax evasion (Steuerhinterziehung, § 370 AO) punishable by imprisonment of up to five years, fines, and asset confiscation; negligent under-declaration (leichtfertige Steuerverkürzung) triggers fines of up to EUR 50,000 under § 379 AO. Managing directors, tax representatives, and fiscal agents are personally liable under §§ 34, 69, and 71 AO and may be pursued civilly. Retrospective clawbacks are time-barred only after the standard four-year assessment period, extended to five years for negligent shortening and ten years for tax evasion (§ 169 AO), and the ELSTER digital filing history provides a full audit trail for such reopenings.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Deutsche Bundesbank (German Central Bank), operating in coordination with the Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (BaFin) for banking supervision and with the German Federal Statistics Office for balance-of-payments reporting under the Foreign Trade and Payments Regulation (Außenwirtschaftsverordnung – AWV).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Germany maintains unrestricted euro convertibility as a member state of the European Union, in accordance with Articles 63–65 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU). Both current-account and capital-account transactions are fully liberalised, with no requirement for any central bank permit, declaration, or administrative approval before converting or remitting profit to non-resident shareholders. Profit remittance is subject only to standard corporate tax withholding and the completion of an annually filed dividend distribution declaration. There is no separate capital account restriction, no Tobin-like transfer tax, and no mechanism that limits reinvestment or repatriation for licensed municipal-utility EPC contractors. The principal administrative requirement is the mandatory reporting of each cross-border payment transaction exceeding EUR 12,500 to the Deutsche Bundesbank, as an external-sector statistical declaration only, not as a precondition of transfer.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. The Federal Republic of Germany does not impose any mandatory surrender, forced conversion, or statutory repatriation timeline for export proceeds received by a resident GmbH. Export receipts in foreign currency may be credited to a freely disposable foreign-currency account, converted into EUR, or applied to procurement commitments without central bank approval. The exporter remains subject to ordinary commercial record-keeping obligations and, where the individual transaction amount exceeds EUR 12,500, must file the monthly AWV balance-of-payments report through its German commercial bank. No minimum conversion ratio and no time limit for holding export proceeds apply.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Project Finance Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: DZ Bank AG (through its cooperative banking network and local municipal banks)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as a primary treasury and clearing rail. An EU/EEA-licensed Electronic Money Institution (EMI) may be tolerated by BaFin for low-value operational expenses, but a cross-border project governed by World Bank escrow rails and SWIFT MT103 wire transfers requires the status of a credit institution under the German Banking Act (KWG). Offshore or non-EU digital EMIs do not possess German or EU passporting rights, cannot open a capital escrow account with a German security interest, and expose the GmbH to unquantified regulatory, sanctions, and client-asset segregation risk. Consequently, offshore digital EMI accounts are not approved for the treasury blueprint of this municipal sewage treatment EPC project.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of at least one managing director (Geschäftsführer) at the German bank branch is mandatory for the initial onboarding interview, signature verification, and activation of high-value corporate accounts and escrow facilities. Remote opening may be permitted only for a German-resident director through an approved video-identification procedure and a certified commercial register excerpt; non-resident directors must present themselves to the German consulate or embassy for identity certification, followed by a physical or remote interview acceptable to the compliance department. Because the account is intended to receive public-sector escrow funding, full face-to-face KYC is the general market mandate and is recommended for all tier-1 institutions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk inbound capital injection from a non-resident corporate parent or beneficial owner without transparent commercial substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified articles of association and registered application (Hauptsatzung/Gesellschaftsvertrag), current Handelsregisterauszug, notarised shareholder resolution on the capital increase, certified shareholder register, source-of-funds documentation for the parent company (audited annual financial statements, latest bank statements, tax filing evidence), declaration of beneficial ownership under the German Money Laundering Act (Geldwäschegesetz), general data protection declaration, and, where applicable, the transfer-pricing documentation describing the cross-border loan or equity contribution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments to municipal authorities, international financial institutions, or sovereign-related counterparties without procurement and award evidence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed EPC contract for the reverse osmosis municipal sewage treatment plant, official public procurement award notice from the contracting municipal authority, valid ISIC 4220 utility license and construction permit, certified engineer’s provisional acceptance certificates, completed environmental impact assessment, World Bank or KfW project reference approval letter, and the final escrow agreement executed between the municipality, the contractor, and the financing institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid inbound-outbound wire pattern inconsistent with a linear construction timeline, suggesting trade-based money laundering or invoice fraud.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Construction schedule and contract budget matching every disbursement milestone, supplier purchase orders and sub-contracts marked with project internal reference numbers, invoice copies with VAT-compliant German or EU tax identification numbers, shipping and delivery confirmations, installation/testing acceptance certificates, bank reconciliation statements for each project account, and an independent audit confirmation from a German Wirtschaftsprüfer verifying treasury movements against the EPC cashflow plan.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inward capital injections are routed from the sending bank to the German GmbH’s tier-1 commercial bank via a SWIFT MT103 payment, carrying a Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference (UETR). The payment remittance reference must include the German corporate name, the commercial register number, the capital contribution resolution number, and the AWV statistical classification code for direct investment (Direktinvestition/Eigenkapital). Upon receipt, the German bank performs sanctions screening, verifies the remitter’s KYC profile, checks the payment against the company’s beneficial ownership register, and files the mandatory Deutsche Bundesbank external-sector report if the amount exceeds EUR 12,500. Reconciliation of the inbound wire is made against the notarised capital increase entry and the subsequent commercial register update.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for EPC procurement and municipal construction costs are cleared through four rail types: (i) SEPA Credit Transfer (SEPA CT) in euros for all EU-27 domiciled suppliers and subcontractors; (ii) SWIFT MT103/UTP with full ISO 20022-compliant structured remittance for non-EU equipment and raw materials suppliers; (iii) Irrevocable Confirmed Documentary Credits issued in accordance with UCP 600 for import of capital plant (pressure vessels, membranes, filtration pumps, and skid-mounted assemblies), payable against a complete set of transport documents and inspection certificates; and (iv) World Bank / KfW escrow disbursement releases executed as MT103 payments after receipt of written No Objection and engineer’s progress certificates, with full audit-trail back-up and multi-signatory approval. Every MT103 message must contain a UETR and clear field 70 references linking the payment to the corresponding EPC milestone and invoice number.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forward contracts (deliverable) in EUR/USD and EUR/GBP with maturity aligned to the EPC payment schedule
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for emerging-market currencies convertible only in restricted liquidity jurisdictions, where the EPC procurement is denominated in such currency
FX swap agreements (devisenswap) for temporary conversion and reconversion of project cash balances
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) when project debt or procurement credit is committed in a non-euro currency

Combination striptures of forward and swap structures solely for hedging and economic-risk mitigation, in compliance with the German Risk Ordinance (MaRisk) and the company’s board-approved treasury and derivative policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months after the financial year-end; electronic submission is generally required.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine proceedings under the German Commercial Code; the minimum Ordnungsgeld is generally EUR 2,500. Persistent non-compliance does not automatically trigger strike-off but may support court enforcement or dissolution measures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements approval and profit appropriation resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GmbH shareholders' meeting; resolutions retained in the corporate records
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally within 8 months after financial year-end for a small GmbH and within 11 months for other GmbHs.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No standard government late fee; directors may incur liability for statutory breaches, delayed filing, creditor prejudice, or insolvency-related violations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return and solidarity surcharge return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent German tax office through ELSTER
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally by 31 July of the following calendar year; tax-adviser filing extension generally applies until the last day of February of the second following year, subject to statutory exceptions.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty generally EUR 25 per commenced month, estimated assessment, late-payment interest, and potential tax audit or enforcement action.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent German tax office through ELSTER; assessment issued by the municipality
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally by 31 July of the following calendar year; tax-adviser extension generally applies under the statutory extended filing period.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty, estimated assessment, interest, and collection measures; the municipality may enforce unpaid trade tax.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent German tax office through ELSTER
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally by 31 July of the following calendar year; tax-adviser extension generally applies under the statutory extended filing period.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty, estimated assessment, late-payment interest, and potential enforcement or audit measures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Transparency Register beneficial ownership data review and update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: German Transparency Register, administered by the Bundesanzeiger Verlag GmbH
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No separate annual confirmation filing; beneficial ownership data must be reviewed at least annually and updated without undue delay after any change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under the German Anti-Money Laundering Act; fines may be substantial for serious, repeated, or intentional non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial register and corporate data review
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent local register court and notary, where a filing is required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual review recommended; changes to managing directors, registered office, share capital, articles, or representation authority must be filed without undue delay.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court-imposed Ordnungsgeld or other enforcement measures may apply; unregistered changes may be ineffective against third parties or create director liability.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory independent audit is generally mandatory if the GmbH is not classified as a small company under the German Commercial Code, normally where at least two of the applicable small-company thresholds are exceeded in the relevant financial years. Additional audit requirements may arise from sector-specific regulation, articles of association, financing documents, or public procurement arrangements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: German Commercial Code accounting principles and German GAAP for standalone statutory accounts. IFRS may be used for qualifying consolidated accounts or voluntarily where legally permitted; it does not generally replace German GAAP for standalone GmbH accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Germany has no standalone annual UBO confirmation filing. The GmbH must maintain accurate beneficial ownership information, conduct periodic annual verification as a control measure, and notify the Transparency Register without undue delay after any change in ownership, control, or relevant personal data. Share transfers must be documented and reflected in the shareholder list submitted to the commercial register.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Accounting records and annual financial statements

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Approximately USD 650-2,200 per year, depending on the city, mail handling, local substance, and compliance services.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Approximately USD 3,200-16,000 for a non-complex GmbH; materially higher for medium or large entities, regulated activities, project-heavy operations, or group reporting.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15.0% Körperschaftsteuer plus 5.5% solidarity surcharge on corporate income tax (0.825% effective), plus Gewerbesteuer (trade tax) at 3.5% base rate times municipal Hebesatz; combined effective headline rate normally between 28% and 32% (illustrative: 30%).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday; eligible relief includes €1,000,000 minimum taxable income band for loss utilization, §8b KStG exemptions for dividends/capital gains, research allowances, declining-balance depreciation for movable assets in certain cases, balance-sheet-based loss carryforwards and interest carryforward (Zinsschranke) under §4h EStG, and possible EU/state aid subsidies for municipal infrastructure; for clean-water EPC projects revenues may qualify for export credit incentives but no free-zone preference.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: German corporate income tax return: Körperschaftsteuererklärung (KSt 1 A); trade tax return: Gewerbesteuererklärung (GewSt 1 A); e-filed mandatorily via ELSTER (ELektronische STEUERerklärung) at www.elster.de, with foreign-connected taxpayers represented by a German tax advisor.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; interim prepayments of corporate income tax and trade tax are due quarterly on 10 February, 10 May, 10 August and 10 November.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing deadline is 31 July of the first calendar year after the relevant tax year; when return is prepared by a tax advisor, the automatic extension is to 28/29 February of the second following calendar year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Main form KSt 1 A – Box 1a (Tax number/identification)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: German Steuernummer, tax year, legal form code, address, foreign shareholder details and place of management.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the German tax number plus country/entity identifier from the commercial register; supply a German registered address for service and a domestic fiscal representative.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconcile commercial-law profit (Handelsbilanzgewinn) to taxable income, including accounting, temporary and permanent differences.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach audited financial statements converted to EUR; if no German GAAP balance sheet is prepared, include a reconciliation from IFRS to tax balance-sheet values.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report exempt dividends, capital gains and foreign DTA-exempt income; adjust 5% non-deductible business expense (Betriebsausgabenabzugsverbot).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident shareholder using the GmbH as a controlled domestic entity, substantiate treaty entitlement and beneficial ownership before applying DTA exempt income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gewerbesteuer add-backs and deductions: 25% of financing costs, rental payments, royalties and 25% of interest expense above statutory thresholds; deductible 1.2% of real property values.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign-owned GmbH must prepare the add-back calculation by reference to the German permanent establishment and cannot allocate add-backs to foreign head office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration on cross-border transactions with related companies, documentation location and arm's-length result.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident investors must ensure cross-border service and financing invoices match the Local File and German principal purpose test evidence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late-filing surcharge (Verspätungszuschlag) of 0.25% of the assessed tax per commenced month, capped at €25,000; upper penalty for lack of e-filing up to €5,000 per return; late-payment interest at 0.15% per month (1.8% per annum); coercive fines (Zwangsmittel) up to €50,000, plus criminal tax-evasion exposure under §370 AO.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 26.375% (25% capital-income tax plus 0.825% solidarity surcharge) for dividends paid by a GmbH to non-resident shareholders; no trade tax on dividend distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Non-resident shareholder must be the beneficial owner and apply to Bundeszentralamt für Steuern (BZSt) for a withholding-exemption certificate or refund; required documents: Certificate of Residence/TRC from home tax authority, shareholder analysis, form for reduction of German withholding tax (Antrag auf Erstattung/Absehung vom Steuerabzug), and where applicable an EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive declaration; treaty rates depend on DTA and are often 5% or 0% for shareholdings ≥10%, subject to beneficial ownership, holding period, and anti-treaty-abuse rules.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 15.825%; DTA relief generally 0% or up to 10% if beneficial owner and substantive rights chain is documented. Interest: ordinary arm's-length cross-border loans are not subject to German withholding tax; profit-participating/convertible debt statutory withholding is 26.375%; treaty rate can be 0% (e.g. interest business profits test). Apply under same BZSt procedure with TRC and lender substance documentation.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File mandatory for cross-border controlled service transactions exceeding EUR 1,000,000 per related party, and for controlled goods transactions exceeding EUR 3,000,000; Master File mandatory when world-wide group turnover exceeds EUR 100,000,000; CbC report mandatory for groups with consolidated revenue ≥ EUR 750,000,000. Thresholds are in EUR.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Germany does not operate a UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) regime, but requires real economic activity and place-of-management analysis; DTA relief and EU Directive benefits are denied when the entity lacks substance or the transaction fails the principal purpose / beneficial ownership test under §50d EStG, §42 AO, MLI and BEPS rules.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly or recklessly submitting false KSt/GewSt returns, omissions of revenue from EPC contract claims, fictitious invoices for subcontracted water-treatment works, or artificial profit shifting to non-resident shareholders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Up to five years' imprisonment or a fine under §370 AO for ordinary tax evasion; up to ten years for aggravated cases; additional fines up to €50,000; back-taxes plus §233a interest of 1.8% per annum and possible penalty of up to 100% of evaded tax when third-party penalties apply.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Managing director and de facto managers are criminally liable; court can impose prison sentence, travel restrictions, asset freeze and restitution; under §73 AO the state demands disgorgement; civil liability to the GmbH/creditors under §43 GmbHG for insolvency-triggering payments.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Missing or incomplete Local File/Master File, failure to disclose related-party transactions, or materially misstating an intercompany pricing benchmark for the reverse-osmosis EPC and commissioning services.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authorities may estimate income and apply a penalty surcharge under §162(4) AO of 5% of the income adjustment, minimum €5,000; severe non-compliance can trigger additional penalty up to €1,000,000 and interest; such documentation orders are not appealable on substantive merits until assessment is issued.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign tax declarations and TP documentation are primary responsible officers; if they fail to present records, personal fines and criminal liability arise under §§370, 378 AO, and liability for resulting tax shortfall can be asserted against the director personally.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company / lack of economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a German GmbH as a letterbox entity without staff, premises, accounting records or decision-making presence; interposing the GmbH in a foreign-owned EPC cash-flow chain solely to obtain treaty benefits, sublicenses or withholding reductions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty and EU Directive benefits via §50d EStG and anti-abuse rules; reallocation of income to the beneficial owner under §39 AO; assessment of dividend/royalty WHT at 26.375%/15.825%; fines and penalties under AML and corporate law; possible registration cancellation in the commercial register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate veil may be pierced for abuse; directors personally liable for deliberate acts under §826 BGB, liable for payments after insolvency under §64 GmbHG, and criminally liable for false balance-sheet statements; travel bans and German arrest warrants are available in extradition proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing World Bank escrow or Swift wire proceeds through unrevealed shell bank accounts, false invoices from sub-contractors, disguised third-party beneficiary payments, or failure to maintain know-your-customer documents for politically exposed counterparties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines under German Anti-Money Laundering Act (GwG) up to €1,000,000 for legal persons and up to €100,000 for individual managers; enhanced registration penalties; freezing/seizure of funds and compulsory license revocation for water-treatment EPC operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are supervisory and reporting officers; breach of AML/KYC duties triggers personal fines, disqualification from management, and personal liability for the financial loss of the project company; criminal conviction for money laundering under §261 StGB carries up to five years' imprisonment.
